title: How An Indian Chips Company Destroyed Lay's

From a small canteen in Gujarat to becoming India’s snack empire, this is the incredible journey of Balaji Wafers. In this video, we break down how a humble family business took on global giants like PepsiCo and ITC and won. Discover the bold decisions, smart pricing, and deep local insights that built a ₹5000+ crore brand from scratch. This is not just a business story, it’s a story of grit, vision, and homegrown innovation.
